row.title: The spinoff headroom read hit the retired account
row.body: ops/free-tier.json stayed at 2026-11-17 because the repo's Cloudflare secret names the retired account and every read since 2026-11-20 got an authz error. foundation/ideas.py now reads the tick's samples through the OIDC route, and the roadmap's spinoff section carries its own date (site/edge.js), so a stale section marks the page stale.

title: The spinoff headroom read hit the retired account
